text.description_html:
Light Spring Aluminum Store Front Door Overhead Concealed Closer

Compact design offers an excellent hidden automatic overhead door closing solution. Center-pivoted for single and double acting (door opens in both directions) doors. Consistent closure speed is assured every time with its temperature-sensitive hydraulic fluid.

This Aluminum store front door overhead concealed closer is a light #3 spring closer, for doors up to 30 inches wide and 125 lbs. For single or double acting doors. Replaces Jackson 20-330 and International 200 series closers.

Also available: Medium Spring Size #4 - Heavy Spring Size #5 - Adjustable Spring Size - Closer Arms and Door Pivots - Jackson 20-330 Concealed Overhead Closer Assembly (with arm or door pivot)

Features and Specifications:

  • Cast Iron Housing
  • High Tensile Steel Camshaft and Pistons
  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Maximum Door Size: 30" exterior
  • Maximum Door Weight: 125 lbs
  • Spring Tension: #3 Light
  • Backstop: 90 or 105 degree Swing
  • Non Handed (Double Acting - swings both ways)
  • Optional Hold Open or non-Hold Open
  • UL Listed
  • 5 Year Warranty
